message.value: You are at a crossroads in the open countryside. It's warm and pleasant for walking.
Four paths are available to you. Three signs, which the wear of time has made almost illegible, give you little information on the direction to take.\nYou can go to...

I am your guardian angel, and I will be there from time to time to give you information about your journey when you need it. Don't hesitate to summon me when I appear. You are now at the starting point of your adventure. You have to make your choice. To the east, you will find a shop where you can buy some useful items. The northern and western paths will allow you to begin your quest.

action.value: Come on, you're not going to return to your monastery without having completed your journey!
This magnificent butterfly seems to bode well for the rest of your journey.

message.value: You are in front of a store. What an idea to start a business in such a peaceful place!
Such a shop, quite miserable and also isolated, must belong to an original... This seems unappealing to you. But, after all, you will see many others!\nWhat do you want to do?
#Enter the store.#\n#Head back towards the crossroads.#

action.value: The melodious song of this bird charms your ears.

message.value: You are at a fork between two mountain roads.

The pass road skirts the sparkling mountain which
stands before you. This passage seems steep
and stony... but you have good legs.
A bright glow at the side of the path catches your eye. You can...

#go northwest towards the pass.#
#go south.#
#go east.#
#examine this glow.#

To the east, you will find Encyclopia Abbey. This is the ultimate goal of your journey. But, to deserve the right to enter this holy abbey, you must have undergone the trials of the two cities of Matem and Litter, as well as those of the island of Histora.\nSo, good luck! May the road be favorable to you!\nDon't forget that I will be there, more often than not, to help you with my informed advice!
You are at a crossroads. You sit for a moment in the shade of a large fir tree.
The green countryside, at the foot of the first rolling foothills, enchants your adventurous spirit. Pleasant walking tones you up.\nTo the south you see an old house.\nYou can go...

#north towards the mountains.#
#south towards the house.#
#east.#
#west.#
#pick flowers in the fields.#

The town of Litter is nearby to the northwest. The trials that the inhabitants of this city have in store for you will surely suit you. You can also go and consult the old wise man who lives in this house, to the south.\nIf you feel like it, you can climb towards the pass, towards Matem and the Abbey, or even return to your starting point.
You are in an old store. Obviously, they sell mainly things to cultivate the mind.
The shopkeeper saw you coming: he is ready to serve you. You feel the greed of his eager gaze weighing on you. Are you going to buy or resell something? You have @gold @pieceor.

#buy a glossary.#
#buy an abacus.#
#buy an atlas.#
#talk to the shopkeeper.#
#leave the store.#
You are in front of a fortified abbey. You think of your monastery, so far away, which you miss...
So, this is the domain of Encyclopia! The site is majestic and emotion grips you at the thought that one day, perhaps, you will be the father director of this abbey...\nWhat do you want to do?
#Enter the abbey.#\n#Head back towards the fork.#
You are at the top of a pass. What a climb! Sweat runs down your neck...
The panorama is magnificent, but fatigue is starting to make itself felt.\nOn your left you see an old mountain hut.\nYou can go...

#to the north.#
#to the southwest.#
#to the southeast.#
#east.#
#towards the mountain shelter.#

The eastern path goes towards the town of Matem. The northern one leads instead to Litter. Perhaps you would prefer to rest for a few moments in the small shelter you see on the left, or even go visit the Sage who lives to the southwest?\nEncyclopia Abbey is located to the southeast.
You are in front of the south gate of the town of Litter.
The fortified city, which stands proudly on a granite peak, seems rich and lively.\nOn the side of the path, you see some very fragrant herbs growing wild.\nYou can ...
#enter the city.#\n#pick the herbs.#\n#go southeast.#
You are in front of an old house. The place seems a cool, peaceful refuge...
Built in front of a grove of deciduous trees and surrounded by flowering embankments, the house seems very welcoming. It must be good to stop there.\nYou can ...
#enter the house.#\n#return to the crossroads.#
You are within the grounds of Encyclopia Abbey, tired but happy to be close to success.
After your hard walk under the blazing sun, you are delighted to find freshness in the paved courtyard. The light scent of flowering rose hips adds to the sweetness of the moment.\nYou can ...

#go to the north tower.#
#go to the south tower.#
#go east.#
#come out of the abbey.#

Ah! I feel better since you entered the abbey. Believe me, it hasn't always been easy being your guardian angel. But, overall, I have to admit that you're pretty good. If ! If ! I say it like I mean it.\nHere, it's simple: the north tower is reserved for contemplative nuns; the south tower is occupied by the copyist monks. To the east, you will finally find the library.
You are at the junction between a path that descends from the mountain and a wider road.
There is an orchard not far in front of you. From here you can see very beautiful red apples, ripe, which only seem to be hanging on the branches waiting for an amateur.\nYou can...

#go south towards the pass.#
#go east.#
#go west.#
#pick some apples.#

On one side, the town of Matem; on the other, that of Litter. What do you choose?\nOr, perhaps you prefer to return to the pass?\nThe orchard you see belongs to the innkeeper on the main road. He is particularly proud of this type of apple that he grows.
You are in sight of the town of Matem which rises below.
Fields of rye and oats stretch almost as far as the eye can see in the valley at your feet. Matica, princess of Matem, must be very rich to own so much fertile land.\nYou can ...

#join the main road.#
#bypass the city#
#down to the river.#
#climb towards the pass.#
#pick flowers in the fields.#

To the north, you will join the road which connects the two towns of Matem and Litter.
Have I ever told you that you can only reach the island of Histora from one of these two towns?
You can also return to the pass.
To the east, you will reach Matem, but is this the right way to enter?
You are in front of a mountain refuge. The coolness of the shade of the trees perks you up.
The refuge, immersed in greenery, most certainly served the surrounding lords during hunting periods. The roof, recently redone, oozes resin and smells of cut fir.\nYou can ...
#enter the shelter.#\n#head back towards the pass.#
You are in an old house. Its owner is a learned scholar, a doctor, perhaps?
A venerable sage welcomes you and asks you to enter his abode. He tells you that he is always looking for books to perfect his knowledge of the world.\nYou can ...
#speak with the wise man.#\n#get out of the house.#

action.key: offer your atlas to the wise.

message.value: You are in the north tower of Encyclopia Abbey.
This tower, cool and clear, is an oratory. A young nun, who was preparing bouquets to decorate the altar, turns to you. She's waiting for you to introduce yourself.\nYou can...
#talk with the nun.#\n#come out of the tower.#\n#Give your flowers to the nun.#

action.key: Give your flowers to the nun.

message.value: You are in the south tower of Encyclopia Abbey.
A smell of ink, leather binding and dried dyes reminds you of your monastery. It is the workshop of the abbey's copyist monks. One of them looks at you kindly.\nYou can ...
#speak with the monk.#\n#come out of the tower.#
You are in front of the abbey library. Everything is peaceful around you.
This is the home of Encyclopia, Keeper of Knowledge! A deep emotion overcomes you... You notice a path which continues towards the east.\nYou can ...
#enter the library.#\n#go east.#\n#go west.#

Do you have the necessary Talents to be accepted by Encyclopia?\nOtherwise, have you gone to look in the abbey towers?\nThe tower I prefer is the one further away, towards the east. Hmm ! It smells so good inside!
You are on the main road, at a crossroads. The heat is overwhelming.

The long walk has exhausted you and the muscles in your calves, strained to the extreme, are making you suffer torture. You sit on the side of the road for a moment. A path leads to an inn. You can go...
#to the inn.#\n#east.#\n#west.#

No ! Go your way! You are not going to enter this place of debauchery, you, a pious and sober monk.\nLitter and Matem are very close. The road is beautiful, safe, and ideal weather for walking.\nFinally ! What I say about it is only advice from a guardian angel.
You are in front of the east gate of Litter. You start to feel tired.
The sea is not very far away and you can smell its acrid scent. Litter impresses you: you have never seen a city this big. A narrow road crosses the moor towards the north.\nYou can ...
#go north.#\n#go east.#\n#enter Litter.#

Here you are in sight of Litter. You can enter right away, there are no guards at the entrance to this city.\nYou can also go towards Matem, either directly or along the coast.\nHave you purchased all the necessary items?
You are at the edge of the river which crosses Matem.

The waves flow quickly towards the city. You are really hesitant about what to do: water is not your favorite element, but, on the other hand, going up this long path through fields hardly inspires you... What to do?
#Dive into the river and swim#\n#to enter Matem.#\n#Retrace your steps.#

Oh, there! there ! The current is fast!
Of course, he would drag you into Matem's heart in less time than it takes to say it... But, in your place, I would be wary.
Finally ! You do as you want. If you sink, I'm here.
Brr! I hope the water isn't too cold. I hate getting my wings wet!

surface.action: Dive into the river and swim

action.key: Dive into the river and swim

message.value: You are in front of Matem Gate, on the main road.
The city of Matem, imposing by the harmony and power of its fortifications, seems invincible. The surrounding countryside exudes serenity. The nearby sea fills the air with salty smells.\nYou can ...

#follow the coast towards the northwest.#
#bypass Matem from the south.#
#enter Matem.#
#go west.#

Here you are in sight of Matem. You can go straight in. But maybe you prefer to go through the south entrance?\nYou can also go towards Litter, either directly or along the coast.\nHave you collected any Talents yet? Don't forget that they are essential to you.

surface.action: follow the coast towards the northwest.

action.key: follow the coast towards the northwest.

message.value: You are in a deserted mountain refuge which must not have been used for several weeks.
The furnishings are basic: an old chest, a solid oak wardrobe, a rickety table and a bed of dubious quality.\nThe unique room smells musty and damp wood.

#You lie down on the bed.#
#You search the cupboard.#
#You search the trunk.#
#You come out of the shelter.#

surface.action: You lie down on the bed.
You come out of the shelter.

action.key: You lie down on the bed.
You come out of the shelter.

message.value: You can answer the wise old man's questions.
Hello @user. You can earn Talents by answering my questions. To do this, you need to answer my question.
You can answer the nun's questions.
@user, before reaching your supreme goal, do you still need Talents? If so, I can get some for you at your convenience.
You can answer the monk's questions.
@user, you come from far away. But you are reaching the goal and your efforts will soon be rewarded. I would be happy, brother, to help you earn some Talents, if you want them.
You are in the Abbey library, opposite Encyclopia.

Finally, you encounter Encyclopia in its rich library. Through your eyelashes, humbly lowered, you perceive his gaze full of kindness and wisdom. She sizes you up with a smile, assessing your abilities to succeed her.
#Hello Encyclopia.#
You are in front of the east tower of Encyclopia Abbey.
The noises and fumes coming from the open window will quickly inform you: you are, without a doubt, facing the entrance to the abbey kitchens. \nYou can ...
#enter the tower.#\n#go west.#
You are in a hostel where the temperature seems more pleasant than outside.
The room is light but smoky. The innkeeper, who wonders about your presence in these places, looks at you with a strange look.\nYou can...
#talk to the innkeeper.#\n#leave the inn.#
You are on the rocky coast. The sea is calm. A strong wind whips your face.

The coast is very steep. On the horizon, the tormented relief of the island of Histora can be seen. A cave is visible to your left. A road runs along the coast to the east. Another goes south.\nYou can ...
#enter the cave.#\n#go south.#\n#follow the coast towards the east.#

Hmm, is it really safe to head towards this cave?
A good surprise, or a bad one, can await you there. It's up to you to make your choice.
To the south, you will find the path to Litter.
To the east, that of Matem.

surface.action: follow the coast towards the east.

action.key: follow the coast towards the east.

message.value: You open the trunk.\nA gnome was sleeping very soundly there.
The gnome jumps to the bottom of the chest, very dissatisfied with this unexpected awakening. Despite his visible anger, you can't help but smile at this surprising appearance.\nYou can ...

#talk to the gnome.#
#grab the gnome and #
#put it back in the trunk.#
#come out of the shelter.#

action.key: put it back in the trunk.

message.value: You open the cupboard whose door creaks. \nInside you see a bag.
Feverishly you take the bag and open it. Joy! You find 20 gold coins inside.\nThese are added to your fortune.
You are in the east tower of Encyclopia Abbey.

Good smells pleasantly tickle your nostrils. The sister cook works at the other end of the room, preparing poultry for dinner the next day. She grumbles about the milkman who didn't come by today. You can...

#talk to the sister.#
#come out of the tower.#
#give your pot of milk#
#to the cook.#
You can answer the innkeeper's questions.
To tell the truth, I'm not used to receiving monks here. Especially your type, @user! Finally, I can do you a favor by helping you earn some Talents, if you answer my question...
You are in a high and deep cave, at the entrance to which a man stands.
A holy hermit greets you. His great age and reserved attitude fill you with admiration and humility. What terrible moments must this man have experienced!\nYou can ...
#talk to the hermit.#\n#come out of the cave.#\n#give your apples to the hermit.#

action.key: give your apples to the hermit.

message.value: The gnome asks you his questions.

I hate being woken up in my first sleep! Finally, since the damage is done... I have some questions to ask you: if you answer, not only will I no longer hold it against you, but I will also offer you Talents.
You can respond to the kitchen guardian sister.
So, it's you, @user. You seem to like the aroma of my soup. I am very happy about it. Hold ! I suggest you glean some Talents.
You can answer the hermit's questions.
God bless you, @user! I'm just a poor old hermit, but maybe I can help you. I have some Talents for you, if you answer my question.
You are against one of the pillars of the Matem bridge, in the center of the city.
The current continues to pull you along despite yourself. Arriving in the center of Matem, you finally manage to cling to the pillar of a bridge and you get out of the water.\nYou can go to...
You are in the Matem river.
You are at a crossroads, near the Matem city gate.
Very close to the Matem gate, four streets appear before you. There is apparently no one to tell you... So let yourself be guided by instinct!\nYou can take the street...

#from the north.#
#South.#
#from the east.#
#from the west.#

To the west is the main gate of Matem. So you can leave the city... But have you accomplished everything you had to do there?\nDo you have the Talisman of Matica with you?\nRemember that it is essential for you to enter the abbey!
You are west of Matem, in front of a jeweler's shop.
The house which houses the jeweler's shop is tall and solidly built. Of course, you are not possessed by the thirst for gold, but you are likely to glean some information inside...\nYou can...
#enter the jewelry store.#\n#return to the intersection.#
You are in front of a house in the western district of Matem.
You follow a miserable alley and, to your great surprise, come out on a pretty square, in front of a large opulent house.\nYou can...
#return to the intersection.#\n#enter the house.#
You are in front of the bridge which spans the Matem River.

The smell of the nearby river is pestilential and you hold your nose, taking the time to examine the neighborhood. You see a bridge to the east; an alley leading south and to the west, a crossroads.\nYou can go...

Here you are in the center of Matem. The bridge that spans the river will take you to the eastern districts of this city, the only way for you to access the island of Histora.\nThe southern street, so I don't advise you to follow it at all.\nYou can also go back west, towards Litter. Perhaps, then, you will stop at the jeweler (if you still have a few gold coins).
You are in a jeweler's shop in the town of Matem.
In fact, the shop is more miserable than one might expect: crude furnishings, lousy dog... The jeweler is hard at work, artfully chiseling a beaded gold chain.\nYou can...
#talk to the jeweler.#\n#come out of the jewelry store.#

surface.action: come out of the jewelry store.

action.key: come out of the jewelry store.
show your nugget to the jeweler.

message.value: You are in a spacious house in the town of Matem.

A servant cleans the floor vigorously and does not hear you enter. Bent over her work, she is only attentive to her task, and the state of the room proves that her masters like cleanliness.\nYou can...

#come out.#
#talk to the servant.#
#give a gold coin#
#to the maid.#
You are at a crossroads, in the center of the town of Matem.

This very important crossroads, on the banks of the river, is visibly the heart of the city. To the east you see a brick building; to the northeast, the path to the port, and, to the north, a large church.\nYou can go...

#northeast towards the port.#
#northwest towards the church.#
#east.#
#west.#

You are in Matem near the bridge that crosses the river. Two streets open before you towards the north: one will take you towards the port or the lighthouse passing in front of Matica's house, the other goes up towards the church of Matem. To the east you can see a barracks.\nDo you still have some gold coins?
You are in front of the famous “boatman’s inn” in Matem.
The street is a dead end which leads to a disreputable inn. Heavy laughter emitted by drunken voices reaches you, coming out in waves from this place.\nYou can...
#return to the bridge.#\n#enter the inn.#
You are in the palace of Matica, queen of Matem.
Matica gives you an hourglass of precious wood, made by one of the many artists she surrounds herself with in her palace. It is a talisman that will allow you to enter Encyclopia Abbey.
You are at the top of the Matem lighthouse. From there, your gaze sweeps over an immense panorama.
You climb to the top of the lighthouse without meeting a soul. In the turret, you see a parchment nailed to one of the roof posts.\nYou can...

#read the parchment.#
#exit the lighthouse.#
#lean over the railing#
#to watch Histora.#
You can answer the jeweler's questions.
Is that you, @user? You scared my poor old dog As I have no hard feelings, I offer you some Talents, in exchange for a good answer to my question.
You can answer the servant's questions.
Are you speaking to me, a humble servant, @user? What an honor you do me! In return, I can earn you some Talents.
You are in front of the barracks of the town of Matem.
An irrascible guard watches the barracks door. Your monk's robe, however, inspires respect and confidence in him. Obviously, he wonders what you are doing in such a place.\nYou can...
#enter the barracks.#\n#return to the crossroads.#
You are at a crossroads, in the northern district of the town of Matem.
This area is very quiet and you stop to get your bearings: to the north, the street should lead to the seaside; to the south you see the bridge and, to the east, a sumptuous palace.\nYou can go...
#to the north.#\n#south.#\n#east.#

Let's imagine that you obtained enough Talents in this city, that you went to visit Matica, that you gave her an abacus, that she gave you a Talisman for Encyclopia... Well, well! One of two things: either you've already been to the island of Histora, or you haven't. In the first case, leave the town to the west to reach Litter or the abbey; in the other case, take the northern street, towards the port.
You are in front of the imposing church in the town of Matem.

The church raises its wide and high facade of pink sandstone in the middle of an esplanade covered with white sand. The place, meticulously maintained, is a guarantee of the devotion of the inhabitants of Matem.\nYou can...
#return to the crossroads.#\n#enter the church.#
You are in the smoky room of the “boatman’s inn”.
The room is very lively: it is obvious that this place is the meeting place for sailors. Moreover, one of them apostrophes you:\n-Hey! monillon, will you down a beer with me?\nYou can...
#accept the invitation.#\n#come out.#\n#buy a bottle of wine.#
You can answer the questions written on the parchment.

You thank heaven for the kindness of the people of Matem who go out of their way to help you. On the parchment, the lighthouse watchman has written several questions for you. You can try your luck and choose...
You are in the courtyard of the Matem barracks.
In the large courtyard, two knights practice using the combat staff. The vanquished begs for mercy, promising that he will soon have his revenge.\nAre you going...
#dare to speak to the victorious knight.#\n#leave the barracks.#

surface.action: dare to speak to the victorious knight.

action.key: dare to speak to the victorious knight.

message.value: You are in front of the palace of Matica, queen of Matem.
You only have 0 Talent. This is not enough to enter Matica's home.\nYou can ...
#return to the intersection.#
You are at the crossroads of two streets, not far from the coast.
To the north, you see the tip of the Matem lighthouse; to the south a crossroads. Towards the west is the city's port. You feel that you are being observed without restraint...\nYou can go...

#to the north.#
#south.#
#west.#
#Give your flowers#
#to the woman at the window.#

Towards the west you will find the port, from where you could embark for Histora or, if you have not been there yet, for Litter.\nYou can also visit the lighthouse watchman, if he is there, which would be surprising given that it is broad daylight.\nTowards the south, you will find yourself in the center of Matem.

action.key: to the woman at the window.

message.value: You are in the church of Matem, in front of a resplendent stained glass window.

Everything here encourages prayer and meditation...\nYou seem to recognize Father Clément, who has already been your Abbot's guest. Clément, priest of Matem, puts on his surplice for the evening service.\nYou can...

#speak with the priest.#
#attend vespers.#
#come out.#
#offer your glossary to the priest.#

action.key: offer your glossary to the priest.

message.value: You are in an herbalist. The bell rings lightly.
All kinds of herbs hang from the ceiling and perfume the room. The shopkeeper, an old man, greets you from his back room.\nYou can ...
#talk to the herbalist.#\n#leave the herbalist's shop.#\n#show your herbs.#
You can answer the sailor's questions.
You, @user, I like your courage! Hey, that makes me decide to help you! If you answer my question, you will be able to leave here richer in Talents.
You can answer the knight's questions.
Wouldn't you be @user, who is talked about everywhere in this town? You don't look like you want to fight. Maybe you prefer a more intellectual fight. I have Talents for you, if you're interested...
You are in the palace of Matica, queen of Matem.
The queen impresses you with her wise gaze and her exquisite beauty. Matica is renowned in the surrounding region for its taste for art and fine literature.\nYou can...
#talk to Matica.#\n#come out.#
You are in front of the lighthouse, on a peninsula in the far north of Matem.
The lighthouse stands straight and majestic, facing a sea of ​​silver. It's broad daylight, and there's a good chance the lighthouse keeper isn't on duty.\nYou can...
#climb into the lighthouse.#\n#return to the intersection.#
You are in the port of the city of Matem.
A caravel anchors in the port, sails raised, in quarantine. On the other hand, a merchant ship is about to set sail.\nYou can...
#board the boat.#\n#go to the intersection.#
You can answer the questions of Father Clément, parish priest of Matem.
Hold ! It's you, @user! I actually heard from my flock that you were in Matem. I can get you Talents if you want.
You are on Histora beach. The site is enchanting.
Histora is an island of wild beauty. Its tortured landscape has always impressed its rare visitors. Two paths are available to you. A boat is attached to a pontoon.\nYou can...

#take the boat to Litter.#
#take the boat to Matem.#
#go northwest.#
#go northeast.#

Here you are on the beach of Histora, the island of the fierce Kronolos. The island is small, and only one road runs from east to west.
The dolmen, which is at the eastern end of the island, is interesting to visit.
Kronolos is looking for a very specific item... Did you bring it to him?
By the way, I didn't lie to you about the price of the crossing.
You are on a large ship in Litter Harbor.
The captain looks at you from head to toe in silence. Perhaps he imagines that you are looking for a job as a foam worker? You have to admit that you don't have the chops for the job!\nYou can...
#talk to the captain.#\n#leave the ship.#
You are on a merchant ship, in the port of Matem.
You are taken near the commander who you find carefully scanning the sea. This story of the caravel's quarantine must intrigue him.\nYou can...
#talk to the commander.#\n#leave the boat.#
You are on your way east, to the island of Histora.

At the top of a small hill, to the north, you see a fisherman's hut. The appearance of this dwelling is not very inviting and the path that leads to it seems steep and poorly maintained.\nYou can go to...

#north.#
#south towards the beach.#
#east.#
#west.#

The fisherman who lives in this cabin is very fearful: try not to impress him too much if you go to see him.\nTo the east, you will head towards the famous dolmen.\nTo the west, you will find the path to Histora beach.
You are on the way west to the island of Histora.
A house with a large shed, certainly a blacksmith's workshop, is at the end of a path towards the north. The pleasant surroundings testify to the ease of the owner.\nYou can go...

#to the north.#
#south towards the beach.#
#east.#
#west.#

The blacksmith is hard at work. I think it's better not to disturb him.
To the south is Histora Beach. To the west, you will find the castle of the master of these places or, depending on your next choice, a cave of great interest.
Have you harvested all the talents you need?
Have a good trip! Enjoy the wonderful landscapes of this island!
You can answer the captain's questions.
Ah! You are @user. It seemed to me that you didn't look like a sailor. How about some Talents? If you answer my question, you will win.
You can answer the commander's questions.
Hello @user. I was waiting for your passage: news travels quickly in a small port like this... I have Talents to offer you if you answer my question. Does this tempt you to try?
You are in front of the house of a poor fisherman from Histora.
The closer you get to the cabin, the more it reveals its miserable appearance. The fisherman who lives here is really not rolling in gold!\nYou can...
#enter the house.#\n#knock on the door.#\n#return to the intersection.#
You are at the end of the eastern path, on the island of Histora.
The path disappears under the dense vegetation. Below you see an old dolmen. You think you can see someone there.\nYou can...

#go towards the dolmen.#
#go west.#
#pick up a handful of these rushes#
#which line the path.#

surface.action: pick up a handful of these rushes
pick up a handful of these rushes

action.key: pick up a handful of these rushes

message.value: You are in front of the Histora blacksmith's workshop.
The hangar doors are wide open. The cow, curious and gentle, comes to meet you. Obviously, your presence intrigues him. Maybe it's milking time?\nYou can...
#enter the workshop.#\n#milk the cow.#\n#return to the intersection.#
You are at the crossroads of two paths, on the island of Histora.

The landscape that stretches out before you is one of the most beautiful you have seen in your life. Sensitive to the magnificence of the site, you meditate for a few moments on the wonders of the world. \nYou can go...
#to the north.#\n#east.#\n#west.#

You are in Litter, at the crossroads between two streets.

The city seems to be celebrating. Perhaps it's a wedding at some bourgeoisie's house. You imagined the atmosphere of a large city like Litter, so famous for its commerce, very differently.\nYou can head to...

You are very close to the south exit of Litter. If you leave this city, do you have the Talisman of Lord Lingus in your bag?\nDue north is the direction of the port. You never know, you might have a boat to catch... Going east would bring you closer to the church.\nBehind the walls of one of these houses, a wedding is in full swing. Go your way.

This neighborhood is more recommendable than the one you would find if you went east.
